title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
statement: Given a string `s`, return the length of the longest substring that contains no repeated characters.
constraints: s consists of English letters, digits, symbols, and spaces
hints: A set of the current window tells you whether the next character is already inside.
When a duplicate appears, shrink the left edge until the window is valid again.
Store the last index of each character so the left edge can jump in one step.

approaches.name: Check every substring
approaches.explanation: Each slice is tested for uniqueness.

editorial: Keep the left edge of a valid window and the most recent index of every character. If s[right] was seen at or after left, move left to that index plus one. The answer is the maximum of right - left + 1. Each index enters and leaves the window at most once.

examples.explanation: The longest piece is abc, length 3.
